identity.name: LangBot
identity.one_liner: Production-grade platform for building agentic IM bots across Discord, Slack, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, and more.
identity.short_description: LangBot is an open-source AI bot project focused on production-grade platform for building agentic im bots across discord, slack, telegram, line, wechat, feishu, dingtalk, and more.

positioning.why_it_matters: LangBot matters because many useful agents will not live only inside an IDE or web app. They need to work inside the communication channels people already use, with source code that can be inspected, self-hosted, and adapted around privacy, permissions, memory, and operational controls.
best_for: Builders evaluating self-hosted AI bots for real messaging channels
Teams comparing Discord, Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Matrix, or WeChat AI assistant options
Developers who want open-source bot infrastructure instead of closed chatbot SaaS
not_for: Teams unwilling to review bot permissions, channel credentials, and data retention policies
Users who only need a hosted consumer chatbot with no deployment work

core_strengths.title: Lives in existing communication channels
core_strengths.description: LangBot brings AI assistance into messaging surfaces rather than forcing users into a separate app.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Bots become useful when they meet users where coordination already happens.

core_strengths.title: Self-hostable source path
core_strengths.description: The public repository lets teams inspect runtime behavior, credentials handling, and integration choices before deployment.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: AI bots can see sensitive conversations, so source review and controlled hosting matter.

core_strengths.title: Good comparison target for agent gateways
core_strengths.description: The project shows how open bots connect LLMs, permissions, plugins, memory, or channel adapters.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: These patterns are likely to become a core part of practical open-agent infrastructure.

compare_notes.title: When to choose LangBot
